static_review.additive_scope: Retains all original V3 BP and independent-margin V1 BPTT checks. Adds fixed-z source directory to trigger/sparse checkout and new protocol/checker seals.
static_review.cli: audit_asset/train_asset take adapter-root,financial-root,protocol-sha256,output; check_asset_results additionally uses root,audit,training. All flags match current actual parsers.
static_review.same_kernel_disclosure: Fixed-z result checker uses one same-frozen-kernel raw-boundary/local-reference batch; it is not a pure-zero-financial-call checker or independent financial oracle.
static_review.failure_propagation: No continue-on-error; both new producer steps require runtime success, checker requires both producers success; preceding numerical failures remain job failures.
static_review.permissions_and_paths: contents:read and persist-credentials:false remain. RUNNER_TEMP paths are initialized only inside a runner step and passed through GITHUB_ENV. Create-only numerical outputs stay outside checkout.

publication_requirement: Publish the exact new fixed-z source/input/protocol and auxiliary checker with this workflow. A prior9-file protocol checkpoint alone does not contain the subsequently authored checker.
decision: Static/identity/expression checks pass for this exact workflow. Actual new-head GitHub execution remains necessary; no scientific or quality gate is changed.
